CHECK SUNROOF CONTROL DEVICES

ALL OK

PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED

ACTION

Check the operation of the sunroof operating devices:

  • with the sunroof fully open, ensure the felt pads are present under the front spoiler;
  • with the sunroof fully open, ensure the teflon mount is present between the slides and rails;
  • with the sunroof open in the swivel position, check the clearance between the central gutter and slides;
  • with the roof open to the swivel setting, check the condition and correct fastening of the central gutter sliding pads.
